    <title>SeSyAM 12 — Platform Belajar</title>

    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700;800&display=swap');

5%;gap:20px}.landinglinks{display:flex;gap:24px;color:#d4e2f8;font-size:13px}.heroContent{width:min(700px,90%);margin:auto 8%;padding:70px 0}.heroContent h1{font:800 clamp(38px,6vw,70px)/1.05 'Playfair Display',serif;margin:15px 0}.heroContent h1 span{color:#9bcaff}.heroContent p{color:#c2d0e6;line-height:1.8;max-width:550px}.heroActions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:25px}.landingfeatures{padding:65px 7%;background:#091831}.landingfeatures button{padding:9px 0;border:1px solid #344d70;background:#0a1930;color:white;border-radius:8px}.numbergrid button.answered{background:#214c77}.numbergrid button.flagged{outline:2px solid var(--gold)}.barrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:130px 1fr 40px;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:12px i{display:block;height:100%;background:#76b5ff}.calendar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:6px}.calendar div{padding:10px 4px;min-height:62px;border:1px solid #263b5c;border-radius:9px;font-size:11px}.calendar .dayname{min-height:30px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);border:0}.calendar .today{border-color:#83baff;background:#17375d}.calendar .has{background:#153e54}.mobilemenu{display:none}
    @media(max-width:950px){.grid.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sidebar{position:fixed;z-index:20;top:68px;bottom:0;left:-270px;width:250px;transition:.25s;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:auto}.sidebar.open{left:0}.mobilemenu{display:inline-flex}.main{padding:22px 17px}.landinglinks{gap:12px}.grid.three{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
    @media(max-width:600px){.topbar{padding:0 14px}.topbar .rightuser{font-size:12px}.grid.stats,.grid.two,.grid.three{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pagehead{flex-direction:column}.heroContent{margin:0 auto;padding:65px 0}.landingnav{padding:18px 5%}.landinglinks a:not(:last-child){display:none}.hero{background-position:58% center}.main{padding:18px 13px}.card{padding:16px}.barrow{grid-template-columns:100px 1fr 30px}.numbergrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}.table{font-size:11px}.table th,.table td{padding:9px 5px}}

    /* SeSyAM 12 feature expansion */
    .feature{background:#0a1a32;border:1px solid #263b5c;border-radius:13px;padding:14px}.feature p{margin:7px 0}.subtest-card{transition:.2s}.subtest-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#5b91cf}.archive-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}.archive-card .btn{align-self:flex-start}.progress-ring{font-size:32px;font-weight:800;color:#9bcaff}.recommendation{border:1px dashed #5479a5;background:#102746;border-radius:14px;padding:15px}.mini-meta{font-size:11px;color:#9aacc8}.tag-row{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:9px 0}@media(max-width:600px){.table{display:block;overflow-x:auto}.archive-card .btn{width:100%}}


    /* ===== RESPONSIVE LAYOUT: HP, TABLET, LAPTOP, DESKTOP ===== */
    html, body { width:100%; max-width:100%; overflow-x:hidden; }
    body { -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%; }
    #app, #modalRoot { width:100%; min-width:0; }
    .layout, .main, .sidebar, .card, .grid, .pagehead, .row, .between { min-width:0; }
    .main { overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
    img, video, canvas, iframe { max-width:100%; }
    input, select, textarea { max-width:100%; min-width:0; }
    .table { max-width:100%; }

    /* Laptop / desktop: navigation stays visible and content uses available width. */
    @media (min-width: 1200px) {
      .layout { grid-template-columns: 250px minmax(0, 1fr); }
      .sidebar { position:relative; left:auto; top:auto; bottom:auto; width:auto; height:auto; overflow:visible; }
      .main { padding:32px clamp(24px, 3vw, 48px); }
      .grid.stats { grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); }
      .grid.two { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
      .grid.three { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); }
    }

    /* Smaller laptops and tablets: collapsible navigation and flexible cards. */
    @media (min-width: 601px) and (max-width: 1199px) {
      .layout { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); }
      .sidebar { position:fixed; z-index:20; top:68px; bottom:0; left:-270px; width:250px; max-width:85vw; overflow-y:auto; }
      .sidebar.open { left:0; }
      .mobilemenu { display:inline-flex; }
      .main { padding:24px clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px); }
      .grid.stats { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
      .grid.two { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
      .grid.three { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
    }

    /* Phones */
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .topbar { min-height:60px; height:auto; padding:10px 12px; gap:8px; }
      .topbar .row { gap:7px; }
      .brand { font-size:13px; letter-spacing:1px; gap:6px; white-space:nowrap; }
      .brandmark { font-size:22px; }
      .topbar .rightuser { gap:6px; font-size:11px; }
      .layout { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); min-height:calc(100vh - 60px); }
      .sidebar { top:60px; width:min(270px,85vw); }
      .main { width:100%; padding:16px 12px; }
      .pagehead { align-items:stretch; }
      .pagehead h1 { font-size:23px; line-height:1.25; }
      .pagehead > div:last-child { max-width:100%; }
      .pagehead .btn, .pagehead button { max-width:100%; }
      .grid.stats, .grid.two, .grid.three { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); }
      .card { padding:14px; border-radius:15px; }
      .stat { font-size:24px; }
      .between { align-items:flex-start; }
      .between > * { min-width:0; }
      .row { max-width:100%; }
      .row > button, .row > a { max-width:100%; }
      .field input, .field select, .field textarea, .search { font-size:16px; }
      .table { display:block; width:100%; overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; }
      .table th, .table td { white-space:normal; }
      .numbergrid { grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr)); }
      .calendar { gap:3px; }
      .calendar div { min-height:48px; padding:7px 2px; font-size:10px; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
      .barrow { grid-template-columns:minmax(70px, 100px) minmax(0,1fr) 28px; gap:7px; }
      .modalback { padding:8px; }
      .modal { width:100%; max-height:94dvh; padding:16px; }
      .modalfoot { flex-wrap:wrap; }
      .modalfoot button { flex:1 1 auto; }
      .hero { min-height:100svh; }
      .heroContent { width:100%; max-width:100%; padding:54px 16px; }
      .landingnav { gap:8px; }
    }

    /* Very narrow phones */
    @media (max-width: 360px) {
      .main { padding-left:9px; padding-right:9px; }
      .topbar { padding-left:8px; padding-right:8px; }
      .topbar .rightuser .muted { display:none; }
      .card { padding:12px; }
      .numbergrid { grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); }
    }

    </style>
    </head>
    <body>
    <div id="app"></div>
    <div id="modalRoot"></div>
    <script>
    const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
    const categories=['Penalaran Umum','Pengetahuan dan Pemahaman Umum','Pemahaman Bacaan dan Menulis','Pengetahuan Kuantitatif','Literasi Bahasa Indonesia','Literasi Bahasa Inggris','Penalaran Matematika'];
    const defaultData={users:[],currentUser:null,profiles:{},schedules:[],goals:[],history:[],studied:[],settings:{reminder:false},scores:[]};
    let data=structuredClone(defaultData),page='landing',quiz=null,quizTimer=null,calendarOffset=0;
    let firebaseUser=null,cloudReady=false,guestMode=false,localAccountMode=false,localAccountUsername='';
    function save(){
      if(guestMode || localAccountMode){
        try{const snapshot={profile:data.profiles[data.currentUser]||{},schedules:data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),goals:data.goals.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),history:data.history.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),studied:data.studied.filter(x=>x.startsWith(data.currentUser+'|')),settings:data.settings||{reminder:false},scores:data.scores.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser)};if(guestMode){localStorage.setItem('sesyam12_guest_data_v1',JSON.stringify(snapshot))}else{const accounts=localAccounts();if(accounts[localAccountUsername]){accounts[localAccountUsername].data=snapshot;localStorage.setItem('sesyam12_local_accounts_v1',JSON.stringify(accounts))}}}catch(e){console.warn('Penyimpanan lokal gagal',e);toast('Penyimpanan perangkat gagal. Periksa ruang penyimpanan browser.')}return;
      }
      if(!window.firebaseUser||!window.firebaseBridge)return;
      const email=data.currentUser;
      const snapshot={profile:data.profiles[email]||{},schedules:data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email===email),goals:data.goals.filter(x=>x.email===email),history:data.history.filter(x=>x.email===email),studied:data.studied.filter(x=>x.startsWith(email+'|')),settings:data.settings||{reminder:false},scores:data.scores.filter(x=>x.email===email),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
      window.firebaseBridge.save(snapshot).catch(err=>{console.error(err);toast('Data belum berhasil disinkronkan. Periksa koneksi internet.')});
    }
    function user(){if(guestMode)return {email:'guest@sesyam.local',name:profile().name||'Pengunjung'};const u=window.firebaseUser;return u?{email:u.email,name:u.displayName||profile().name||u.email}:null}
    function enterGuest(){guestMode=true;window.firebaseUser=null;const email='guest@sesyam.local';let saved={};try{saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sesyam12_guest_data_v1')||'{}')}catch(e){};data={...structuredClone(defaultData),currentUser:email,users:[{email,name:saved.profile?.name||'Pengunjung'}],profiles:{[email]:saved.profile||{name:'Pengunjung',school:'',grade:'12',targetPTN:'',targetProdi:'',targetHours:20,targetQuestions:150}},schedules:(saved.schedules||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),goals:(saved.goals||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),history:(saved.history||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),studied:saved.studied||[],settings:saved.settings||{reminder:false},scores:(saved.scores||[]).map(x=>({...x,email}))};page='dashboard';render();toast('Mode tamu aktif. Data tersimpan hanya di perangkat ini.')}

    function profile(){return data.profiles[data.currentUser]||{}}
    function esc(s=''){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
    function dateISO(d=new Date()){return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}
    function fmtDate(s){return new Date(s+'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('id-ID',{day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'})}
    function durationHours(){return data.schedules.filter(x=>x.done&&x.email===data.currentUser).reduce((a,x)=>a+Math.max(0,(+x.end.split(':')[0]*60 + +x.end.split(':')[1] - (+x.start.split(':')[0]*60 + +x.start.split(':')[1]))/60),0)}
    function userHistory(){return data.history.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser)}
    function totalQuestions(){return userHistory().reduce((a,x)=>a+(x.total||0),0)}
    function avgScore(){let a=userHistory().filter(x=>x.score!=null);return a.length?Math.round(a.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.score,0)/a.length):0}
    let requestedFeaturePage=null;
    function go(p){page=p;render();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
    function openFeature(p){if(data.currentUser){go(p);return}requestedFeaturePage=p;go('login');toast('Masuk atau coba sebagai tamu untuk membuka fitur ini.')}
    function toast(msg){let t=document.createElement('div');t.textContent=msg;t.style='position:fixed;bottom:22px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#dcecff;color:#071329;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:12px;z-index:99;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0007';document.body.append(t);setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),2600)}
    function landing(){return `<div class="hero"><nav class="landingnav"><div class="brand"><span class="brandmark">✦</span> SeSyAM 12</div><div class="landinglinks"><a href="#home">Beranda</a><a href="#fitur">Fitur</a><a href="#tentang">Tentang Kami</a><a href="#" onclick="go('login')">Login</a></div></nav><section class="heroContent" id="home"><div class="eyebrow">PLAN ✦ STUDY ✦ GROW</div><h1>Wujudkan Kampus<br>Impianmu Bersama<br><span>SeSyAM 12!</span></h1><p>Teman persiapan UTBK-SNBT untuk merencanakan belajar, memahami materi, berlatih soal, dan memantau progres menuju PTN impianmu.</p><div class="heroActions"><button class="btn" onclick="go(data.currentUser?'dashboard':'register')">Mulai Persiapan ↗</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="enterGuest()">Coba sebagai Tamu</button><a class="btn ghost" href="#fitur">Jelajahi Fitur</a></div><div class="row" style="margin-top:35px;color:#c5d5ee;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px">✧ BETTER PLAN　✦　DEEPER FOCUS　✦　BRIGHTER FUTURE</div></section></div><section class="landingfeatures" id="fitur"><div class="eyebrow" style="text-align:center">YOUR UTBK COMPANION</div><h2>Semua Persiapan dalam Satu Tempat</h2><div class="grid three">${[['🗓️','Jadwal Terarah','Atur agenda belajar dan jaga konsistensi setiap hari.','schedule'],['📚','Materi UTBK','Pelajari tujuh subtes UTBK secara bertahap.','materials'],['✍️','Latihan & Tryout','Uji kemampuan dengan soal orisinal dan evaluasi.','practice'],['🎯','Target Belajar','Tetapkan tujuan kecil yang membawamu lebih dekat.','goals'],['📈','Pantau Progres','Lihat perkembangan nilai dan aktivitas belajarmu.','progress'],['🏛️','Simulasi SNBT','Pelajari tingkat persaingan program studi tujuan.','simulation']].map(x=>`<button type="button" class="feature feature-link" onclick="openFeature('${x[3]}')"><div class="emoji">${x[0]}</div><h3>${x[1]}</h3><p>${x[2]}</p><span class="feature-cta">Buka halaman →</span></button>`).join('')}</div></section><section class="landingfeatures" id="tentang" style="padding-top:15px;text-align:center"><h2>Persiapkan Dirimu, Raih Kampus Impianmu!</h2><p class="muted">SeSyAM 12 — Sistem Edukasi dan Manajemen Akademik Kelas 12.</p></section><footer class="footer">© 2026 SeSyAM 12 · Belajar terarah, tumbuh lebih percaya diri.</footer>`}
    function auth(type){return `<div class="authwrap"><div class="card authbox"><div class="brand"><span class="brandmark">✦</span> SeSyAM 12</div><div class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:25px">${type==='login'?'WELCOME BACK':'START YOUR JOURNEY'}</div><h1>${type==='login'?'Masuk ke akunmu':'Buat akun SeSyAM'}</h1><p class="muted small">${type==='login'?'Lanjutkan perjalanan menuju kampus impian.':'Mulai rencanakan persiapan UTBK-mu.'}</p><form onsubmit="${type==='login'?'login(event)':'register(event)'}">${type==='register'?`<div class="field"><label>Nama lengkap</label><input name="name" required maxlength="80" placeholder="Nama kamu"></div>`:''}<div class="field"><label>Username</label><input name="username" type="text" required minlength="3" maxlength="24" pattern="[A-Za-z0-9_]+" autocomplete="username" placeholder="Contoh: april123"><small class="muted">3–24 karakter, hanya huruf, angka, dan underscore (_).</small></div><div class="field"><label>Password</label><input name="password" type="password" required minlength="6" autocomplete="${type==='login'?'current-password':'new-password'}" placeholder="Minimal 6 karakter"></div><button type="submit" class="btn" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px">${type==='login'?'Login':'Daftar Sekarang'}</button></form><p class="small muted" style="text-align:center;margin-top:18px">${type==='login'?`Belum punya akun? <a style="color:#9bcaff" href="#" onclick="go('register')">Daftar</a>`:`Sudah punya akun? <a style="color:#9bcaff" href="#" onclick="go('login')">Login</a>`}</p><button class="iconbtn" style="width:100%" onclick="enterGuest()">Coba tanpa akun sebagai Tamu</button><button class="iconbtn" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px" onclick="go('landing')">← Kembali ke Beranda</button><p class="small muted">Buat akun cukup dengan username dan password. Jika Firebase belum diatur, akun disimpan di browser/perangkat ini.</p></div></div>`}
    async function passwordDigest(password){if(!window.crypto?.subtle)throw new Error('Browser belum mendukung pembuatan akun lokal. Buka website melalui HTTPS atau gunakan browser terbaru.');const hash=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(String(password)));return [...new Uint8Array(hash)].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
    function localAccounts(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sesyam12_local_accounts_v1')||'{}')}catch(e){return {}}}
    function activateLocalAccount(username,account){guestMode=false;localAccountMode=true;localAccountUsername=username;window.firebaseUser=null;const email=username+'@sesyam.local',saved=account.data||{};data={...structuredClone(defaultData),currentUser:email,users:[{email,name:account.name}],profiles:{[email]:saved.profile||{name:account.name,username,school:'',grade:'12',targetPTN:'',targetProdi:'',targetHours:20,targetQuestions:150}},schedules:(saved.schedules||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),goals:(saved.goals||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),history:(saved.history||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),studied:saved.studied||[],settings:saved.settings||{reminder:false},scores:(saved.scores||[]).map(x=>({...x,email}))};page='dashboard';render()}
    async function login(e){e.preventDefault();const f=new FormData(e.currentTarget),username=String(f.get('username')||'').trim().toLowerCase(),password=String(f.get('password')||'');if(!/^[a-z0-9_]{3,24}$/.test(username))return toast('Username harus 3–24 karakter dan hanya boleh berisi huruf, angka, atau underscore.');try{if(window.firebaseBridge){await window.firebaseBridge.login(username,password);return}const account=localAccounts()[username];if(!account)return toast('Akun tidak ditemukan. Silakan daftar terlebih dahulu.');if(await passwordDigest(password)!==account.passwordHash)return toast('Password salah. Periksa kembali password kamu.');activateLocalAccount(username,account)}catch(err){toast(err.message||authError(err))}}
    async function register(e){e.preventDefault();const f=new FormData(e.currentTarget),name=String(f.get('name')||'').trim(),username=String(f.get('username')||'').trim().toLowerCase(),password=String(f.get('password')||'');if(!name)return toast('Nama lengkap wajib diisi.');if(!/^[a-z0-9_]{3,24}$/.test(username))return toast('Username harus 3–24 karakter dan hanya boleh berisi huruf, angka, atau underscore.');if(password.length<6)return toast('Password minimal 6 karakter.');try{if(window.firebaseBridge){const cred=await window.firebaseBridge.register(name,username,password);window.firebaseUser=cred.user;data.currentUser=cred.user.email;data.users=[{email:cred.user.email,name}];data.profiles[cred.user.email]={name,username,school:'',grade:'12',targetPTN:'',targetProdi:'',targetHours:20,targetQuestions:150};save();const dest=requestedFeaturePage||'dashboard';requestedFeaturePage=null;go(dest);return}const accounts=localAccounts();if(accounts[username])return toast('Username sudah digunakan. Silakan pilih username lain.');const passwordHash=await passwordDigest(password);const account={name,passwordHash,data:{profile:{name,username,school:'',grade:'12',targetPTN:'',targetProdi:'',targetHours:20,targetQuestions:150},schedules:[],goals:[],history:[],studied:[],scores:[],settings:{reminder:false}}};accounts[username]=account;localStorage.setItem('sesyam12_local_accounts_v1',JSON.stringify(accounts));activateLocalAccount(username,account);toast('Akun berhasil dibuat! Data tersimpan di perangkat ini.')}catch(err){toast(err.message||authError(err))}}
    async function resetPassword(){const email=document.querySelector('input[name="email"]')?.value.trim();if(!email)return toast('Masukkan email terlebih dahulu.');try{await window.firebaseBridge.resetPassword(email);toast('Tautan pemulihan password dikirim jika email terdaftar.')}catch(err){toast(authError(err))}}
    function authError(err){const map={'auth/email-already-in-use':'Username sudah digunakan. Silakan pilih username lain.','auth/invalid-email':'Username tidak valid.','auth/weak-password':'Password terlalu lemah. Gunakan minimal 6 karakter.','auth/invalid-credential':'Username atau password tidak sesuai.','auth/user-not-found':'Akun tidak ditemukan.','auth/too-many-requests':'Terlalu banyak percobaan. Coba lagi nanti.','auth/not-configured':'Login belum aktif karena konfigurasi Firebase pada file ini belum diisi.'};return map[err?.code]||'Autentikasi gagal. Periksa koneksi dan konfigurasi Firebase.'}
    const nav=[['dashboard','⌂','Dashboard'],['schedule','▦','Jadwal Belajar'],['materials','▤','Materi UTBK'],['practice','✎','Latihan Soal'],['tryout','◷','Tryout'],['simulation','▣','Simulasi SNBT'],['chance','⚑','Peluang SNBT'],['goals','◎','Goals / Target'],['progress','▥','Progres Belajar'],['history','↺','Riwayat'],['profile','♙','Profil Saya'],['settings','⚙','Pengaturan']];
    function shell(){return `<header class="topbar"><div class="row"><button class="iconbtn mobilemenu" onclick="$('.sidebar').classList.toggle('open')">☰</button><div class="brand"><span class="brandmark">✦</span> SeSyAM 12</div></div><div class="row rightuser"><span class="muted">Halo, ${esc(profile().name||user().name)}</span><button class="iconbtn" onclick="go('profile')">♙</button></div></header><div class="layout"><aside class="sidebar">${nav.map(n=>`<button class="navitem ${page===n[0]?'active':''}" onclick="go('${n[0]}');$('.sidebar').classList.remove('open')"><span class="navicon">${n[1]}</span>${n[2]}</button>`).join('')}<div class="side-label">AKUN</div>${guestMode?'<div class="side-label">MODE TAMU · DATA LOKAL</div>':''}<button class="navitem" onclick="logout()"><span class="navicon">⇥</span>${guestMode?'Akhiri Mode Tamu':'Keluar'}</button></aside><main class="main">${content()}</main></div>`}
    function head(title,desc,action=''){return `<div class="pagehead"><div><div class="eyebrow">SeSyAM 12 / ${title}</div><h1>${title}</h1><p>${desc}</p></div>${action}</div>`}
    function dashboard(){let today=dateISO(),todayList=data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser&&x.date===today),done=todayList.filter(x=>x.done).length,goals=data.goals.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),goalPct=goals.length?Math.round(goals.reduce((a,g)=>a+(g.progress||0),0)/goals.length):0;let exam=new Date('2027-04-01T00:00:00'),days=Math.ceil((exam-new Date())/86400000);return `${head('Dashboard','Ringkasan perjalanan persiapan UTBK-SNBT kamu.')}<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:17px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#173d68,#102344)"><div class="eyebrow">KEEP MOVING FORWARD ✦</div><h2 style="margin:8px 0">Halo, ${esc(profile().name||user().name)}! 👋</h2><p class="muted">Satu langkah kecil hari ini membawa kamu lebih dekat ke kampus impian.</p><div class="row"><span class="pill">📅 ${fmtDate(today)}</span><span class="pill gold">⏳ ${days>0?days+' hari menuju 1 April 2027':'Perbarui tanggal UTBK di pengaturan'}</span></div></div><div class="grid stats"><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">⏱️ TOTAL JAM BELAJAR</div><div class="stat">${durationHours().toFixed(1)} <small style="font-size:13px">jam</small></div><div class="small muted">Dari jadwal selesai</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">✍️ SOAL DIKERJAKAN</div><div class="stat">${totalQuestions()}</div><div class="small muted">Total latihan & tryout</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">📈 RATA-RATA SKOR</div><div class="stat">${avgScore()}<small style="font-size:13px">/100</small></div><div class="small muted">Dari riwayat latihan</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">🎯 TARGET TERCAPAI</div><div class="stat">${goalPct}%</div><div class="progress"><span style="width:${goalPct}%"></span></div></div></div><div class="grid two" style="margin-top:17px"><div class="card"><div class="between"><h3>Jadwal Hari Ini</h3><button class="iconbtn" onclick="go('schedule')">Lihat semua →</button></div>${todayList.length?todayList.map(x=>`<div class="between" style="padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #263b5c"><div><b>${esc(x.category)}</b><div class="small muted">${x.start}–${x.end} · ${x.target||0} soal</div></div><span class="pill ${x.done?'green':''}">${x.done?'Selesai':'Terjadwal'}</span></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty">Belum ada jadwal hari ini. Yuk, susun rencana belajarmu!</div>'}<button class="btn ghost" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="openSchedule()">+ Tambah Jadwal</button></div><div class="card"><div class="between"><h3>Perkembangan Skor</h3><button class="iconbtn" onclick="go('progress')">Detail →</button></div>${scoreBars()}<p class="small muted">Grafik diambil dari hasil latihan yang tersimpan.</p></div></div><div class="grid two" style="margin-top:17px"><div class="card"><h3>Target Mingguan</h3><p class="muted small">Penyelesaian target yang kamu buat.</p><div class="stat">${goalPct}%</div><div class="progress"><span style="width:${goalPct}%"></span></div><button class="btn ghost" style="margin-top:14px" onclick="go('goals')">Kelola target</button></div><div class="card"><h3>Akses Cepat</h3><div class="grid two"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="go('practice')">✎ Mulai Latihan</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="go('materials')">▤ Buka Materi</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="go('tryout')">◷ Tryout</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="go('chance')">⚑ Cek Persaingan</button></div></div></div>`}
    function scoreBars(){let a=userHistory().filter(x=>x.score!=null).slice(-6);return a.length?a.map(x=>`<div class="barrow"><span>${esc(x.label||'Latihan')}</span><div class="bar"><i style="width:${x.score}%"></i></div><b>${x.score}</b></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty">Belum ada skor. Kerjakan latihan pertamamu!</div>'}
    function schedulePage(){let arr=data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser).sort((a,b)=>(a.date+a.start).localeCompare(b.date+b.start)),today=dateISO(),week=arr.filter(x=>{let d=new Date(x.date+'T00:00:00'),n=new Date();let diff=(d-n)/86400000;return diff>=0&&diff<7});return `${head('Jadwal Terarah','Susun agenda belajar sesuai waktu luangmu. Semua jadwal dapat dibuat, diedit, dan dihapus.',`<button class="btn" onclick="openSchedule()">+ Buat Jadwal</button>`)}<div class="grid stats"><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">TOTAL JADWAL</div><div class="stat">${arr.length}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">SELESAI</div><div class="stat">${arr.filter(x=>x.done).length}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">MINGGU INI</div><div class="stat">${week.length}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">BELUM SELESAI</div><div class="stat">${arr.filter(x=>!x.done).length}</div></div></div><div class="grid two" style="margin-top:17px"><div class="card"><div class="between"><h3>Daftar Jadwal</h3><input class="search" style="max-width:155px" type="date" value="${today}" onchange="filterSchedule(this.value)"></div><div class="tag-row"><button class="iconbtn" onclick="filterSchedule('${today}')">Hari ini</button><button class="iconbtn" onclick="filterSchedule('all')">Semua jadwal</button></div><div id="scheduleList">${scheduleRows(arr)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="between"><h3>Kalender Belajar</h3><div class="row"><button class="iconbtn" onclick="changeMonth(-1)">‹</button><button class="iconbtn" onclick="changeMonth(1)">›</button></div></div><div id="calendar">${calendarHTML()}</div><p class="small muted">Pilih tanggal untuk melihat agenda pada hari tersebut.</p></div></div><div class="card" style="margin-top:17px"><div class="between"><h3>Saran Jadwal Belajar</h3><button class="btn ghost" onclick="recommendSchedule()">Buat saran jadwal</button></div><p class="small muted">Contoh waktu setelah pulang sekolah. Jadwal saran tetap bisa kamu ubah.</p><div class="grid three"><div class="feature"><b>16.00–17.00</b><p class="small muted">Istirahat dan kegiatan ringan</p></div><div class="feature"><b>17.00–18.00</b><p class="small muted">Review materi atau tugas</p></div><div class="feature"><b>19.00–20.00</b><p class="small muted">Fokus latihan TKA / UTBK</p></div></div></div>`}
    function scheduleRows(arr){return arr.length?arr.map(x=>`<div class="between" style="padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #263b5c;gap:8px"><div style="min-width:0"><b>${esc(x.category)}</b><div class="small muted">${fmtDate(x.date)} · ${x.start}–${x.end} · ${x.target} soal</div><div class="small muted">${esc(x.note||'')}</div></div><div class="row"><span class="pill ${x.done?'green':''}">${x.done?'Selesai':'Aktif'}</span><button class="iconbtn" onclick="toggleSchedule('${x.id}')">${x.done?'↶':'✓'}</button><button class="iconbtn" onclick="openSchedule('${x.id}')">✎</button><button class="iconbtn" onclick="deleteSchedule('${x.id}')">×</button></div></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty">Tidak ada jadwal untuk tanggal ini.</div>'}
    function filterSchedule(v){let a=data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser&&(v==='all'||x.date===v)).sort((x,y)=>(x.date+x.start).localeCompare(y.date+y.start));$('#scheduleList').innerHTML=scheduleRows(a)}
    function calendarHTML(){let now=new Date(),d=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth()+calendarOffset,1),year=d.getFullYear(),month=d.getMonth(),start=new Date(year,month,1).getDay(),days=new Date(year,month+1,0).getDate(),events=data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser).map(x=>x.date);return `<div class="small muted" style="text-align:center;margin:10px">${d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})}</div><div class="calendar">${['Min','Sen','Sel','Rab','Kam','Jum','Sab'].map(x=>`<div class="dayname">${x}</div>`).join('')}${Array.from({length:start},()=>'<div></div>').join('')}${Array.from({length:days},(_,i)=>{let n=i+1,key=year+'-'+String(month+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(n).padStart(2,'0');return `<div class="${key===dateISO()?'today ':''}${events.includes(key)?'has':''}" onclick="filterSchedule('${key}')"><b>${n}</b>${events.includes(key)?'<div style="color:#9bcaff">• agenda</div>':''}</div>`}).join('')}</div>`}
    function changeMonth(n){calendarOffset+=n;$('#calendar').innerHTML=calendarHTML()}
    function openSchedule(id){let x=data.schedules.find(a=>a.id===id)||{};showModal(`<h2>${id?'Edit':'Tambah'} Jadwal</h2><form id="scheduleForm"><div class="field"><label>Tanggal</label><input name="date" type="date" required value="${x.date||dateISO()}"></div><div class="grid two"><div class="field"><label>Jam mulai</label><input name="start" type="time" required value="${x.start||'08:00'}"></div><div class="field"><label>Jam selesai</label><input name="end" type="time" required value="${x.end||'09:00'}"></div></div><div class="field"><label>Kategori UTBK</label><select name="category">${categories.map(c=>`<option ${x.category===c?'selected':''}>${c}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Target soal</label><input name="target" type="number" min="0" value="${x.target??20}"></div><div class="field"><label>Catatan</label><textarea name="note">${esc(x.note||'')}</textarea></div><div class="modalfoot"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Batal</button><button class="btn">Simpan</button></div></form>`);$('#scheduleForm').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();let f=new FormData(e.target),start=f.get('start'),end=f.get('end');if(end<=start)return toast('Jam selesai harus setelah jam mulai.');let obj={id:id||crypto.randomUUID(),email:data.currentUser,date:f.get('date'),start,end,category:f.get('category'),target:+f.get('target'),note:f.get('note'),done:x.done||false};if(id)data.schedules=data.schedules.map(a=>a.id===id?obj:a);else data.schedules.push(obj);save();closeModal();render();toast('Jadwal tersimpan.')}}
    function toggleSchedule(id){let x=data.schedules.find(a=>a.id===id);x.done=!x.done;if(x.done)data.history.push({id:crypto.randomUUID(),email:data.currentUser,type:'Jadwal selesai',label:x.category,date:dateISO(),total:0});save();render()}
    function deleteSchedule(id){if(confirm('Hapus jadwal ini?')){data.schedules=data.schedules.filter(x=>x.id!==id);save();render()}}
    function recommendSchedule(){let d=new Date(),added=0,slots=[['17:00','18:00'],['19:00','20:00'],['17:00','18:00'],['19:00','20:00'],['17:00','18:00']];categories.slice(0,5).forEach((c,i)=>{let day=new Date(d);day.setDate(d.getDate()+i);let date=dateISO(day);if(!data.schedules.some(x=>x.email===data.currentUser&&x.date===date)){data.schedules.push({id:crypto.randomUUID(),email:data.currentUser,date,start:slots[i][0],end:slots[i][1],category:c,target:20,note:'Saran jadwal belajar — silakan edit sesuai kebutuhan',done:false});added++}});save();render();toast(added+' jadwal rekomendasi ditambahkan.')}
    const topics={ 'Penalaran Umum':['Penalaran induktif','Penalaran deduktif','Analisis argumen','Pola dan hubungan'], 'Pengetahuan dan Pemahaman Umum':['Makna kata dan istilah','Hubungan antar kalimat','Pengetahuan kontekstual'], 'Pemahaman Bacaan dan Menulis':['Ide pokok','Simpulan bacaan','Koherensi dan kohesi','Perbaikan kalimat'], 'Pengetahuan Kuantitatif':['Operasi bilangan','Aljabar dasar','Perbandingan dan rasio','Statistika dan peluang'], 'Literasi Bahasa Indonesia':['Informasi tersurat dan tersirat','Evaluasi argumen','Interpretasi teks'], 'Literasi Bahasa Inggris':['Main idea','Inference','Vocabulary in context','Text purpose'], 'Penalaran Matematika':['Fungsi dan persamaan','Geometri','Data dan peluang','Pemodelan matematika']};
    const topicNotes={
    'Penalaran induktif':'Penalaran induktif menarik kesimpulan umum dari beberapa contoh atau pola khusus. Amati keteraturan data, cari aturan yang konsisten, lalu uji aturan itu pada contoh lain.',
    'Penalaran deduktif':'Penalaran deduktif bergerak dari premis umum menuju kesimpulan khusus. Pastikan kesimpulan mengikuti premis; jangan menambahkan asumsi yang tidak disebutkan.',
    'Analisis argumen':'Identifikasi klaim utama, alasan pendukung, bukti, dan asumsi. Bedakan fakta dari opini serta tentukan apakah bukti benar-benar mendukung kesimpulan.',
    'Pola dan hubungan':'Cari perubahan, pengulangan, perbandingan, atau hubungan antarunsur. Pada pola angka, uji operasi sederhana dan selisih sebelum menyimpulkan aturan.',
    'Makna kata dan istilah':'Tentukan makna kata dari konteks kalimat, imbuhan, dan hubungan dengan kata di sekitarnya. Perhatikan sinonim, antonim, makna denotatif, dan konotatif.',
    'Hubungan antar kalimat':'Perhatikan hubungan sebab-akibat, pertentangan, penambahan, perbandingan, dan penjelasan. Kata penghubung membantu menunjukkan hubungan logis antargagasan.',
    'Pengetahuan kontekstual':'Gunakan informasi dalam stimulus untuk memahami istilah dan isu umum. Utamakan petunjuk teks, bukan sekadar mengandalkan hafalan di luar konteks.',
    'Ide pokok':'Ide pokok adalah gagasan utama yang menjadi dasar paragraf. Temukan kalimat yang paling mewakili keseluruhan isi, bukan contoh atau detail pendukung.',
    'Simpulan bacaan':'Simpulan merangkum gagasan penting dan harus didukung isi bacaan. Hindari kesimpulan yang terlalu luas, bertentangan, atau menambahkan informasi baru.',
    'Koherensi dan kohesi':'Koherensi berkaitan dengan kepaduan makna, sedangkan kohesi berkaitan dengan keterkaitan bentuk bahasa. Periksa rujukan kata, konjungsi, dan urutan gagasan.',
    'Perbaikan kalimat':'Kalimat efektif harus jelas, hemat, logis, dan sesuai kaidah. Periksa subjek-predikat, kesejajaran bentuk, pilihan kata, serta penggunaan tanda baca.',
    'Operasi bilangan':'Kuasai operasi bilangan bulat, pecahan, desimal, persen, pangkat, dan akar. Ikuti urutan operasi serta sederhanakan perhitungan secara bertahap.',
    'Aljabar dasar':'Gunakan variabel untuk mewakili nilai yang belum diketahui. Sederhanakan suku sejenis, gunakan sifat distributif, dan lakukan operasi yang sama pada kedua ruas persamaan.',
    'Perbandingan dan rasio':'Rasio membandingkan dua besaran. Samakan satuan terlebih dahulu, lalu gunakan perbandingan senilai atau berbalik nilai sesuai hubungan pada soal.',
    'Statistika dan peluang':'Statistika mencakup mean, median, modus, dan penyebaran data. Peluang kejadian sederhana dihitung dari banyak hasil yang diinginkan dibanding seluruh hasil yang mungkin.',
    'Informasi tersurat dan tersirat':'Informasi tersurat dinyatakan langsung dalam teks. Informasi tersirat diperoleh melalui petunjuk dan hubungan antarkalimat tanpa bertentangan dengan isi bacaan.',
    'Evaluasi argumen':'Nilai kekuatan argumen dengan memeriksa relevansi bukti, kecukupan data, dan kemungkinan bias. Tentukan informasi yang memperkuat atau melemahkan klaim.',
    'Interpretasi teks':'Hubungkan gagasan, data, tujuan penulis, dan konteks teks. Perhatikan tabel atau grafik bila tersedia dan jangan menyimpulkan melebihi data.',
    'Main idea':'The main idea is the central point of a paragraph or passage. Look for the idea supported by most sentences, not a single example or minor detail.',
    'Inference':'An inference is a logical conclusion based on clues in the text. Combine relevant details and avoid choices that introduce unsupported information.',
    'Vocabulary in context':'Use nearby words, sentence meaning, contrast markers, and examples to infer an unfamiliar word. Choose the meaning that fits the passage, not just its first dictionary meaning.',
    'Text purpose':'Identify why the writer created the text: to inform, explain, compare, persuade, describe, or entertain. Use tone, structure, and key phrases as clues.',
    'Fungsi dan persamaan':'Pahami hubungan input dan output pada fungsi serta cara menyelesaikan persamaan. Substitusikan nilai dengan teliti dan periksa kembali hasilnya.',
    'Geometri':'Kenali sifat bangun datar dan ruang, sudut, keliling, luas, volume, serta kesebangunan. Buat sketsa sederhana untuk membantu membaca informasi.',
    'Data dan peluang':'Baca tabel, diagram, dan grafik dengan cermat. Tentukan informasi yang relevan, hitung ukuran data atau peluang, lalu tafsirkan hasil sesuai konteks.',
    'Pemodelan matematika':'Ubah situasi nyata menjadi variabel, persamaan, tabel, atau diagram. Selesaikan model dan tafsirkan kembali hasilnya dalam konteks soal.'
    };
    function materials(){return `${head('Materi UTBK','Pilih salah satu dari tujuh subtes untuk membuka daftar materi dan menandai topik yang sudah dipelajari.')}<div class="grid two">${categories.map((c,i)=>{let ts=topics[c],done=ts.filter(t=>data.studied.includes(data.currentUser+'|'+c+'|'+t)).length;return `<div class="card subtest-card"><div class="between"><span class="pill">SUBTES 0${i+1}</span><span class="small muted">${done}/${ts.length} topik</span></div><h3 style="margin-top:13px">${c}</h3><div class="progress"><span style="width:${done/ts.length*100}%"></span></div><div style="margin-top:12px">${ts.map(t=>`<div class="between" style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #263b5c"><span class="small">${esc(t)}</span><button class="iconbtn" onclick="openTopic('${c}','${t}')">${data.studied.includes(data.currentUser+'|'+c+'|'+t)?'✓ Dipelajari':'Buka materi →'}</button></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`}).join('')}</div>`}
    function openTopic(c,t){let done=data.studied.includes(data.currentUser+'|'+c+'|'+t),note=topicNotes[t]||'Pahami informasi utama, kenali hubungan antarbagian, lalu gunakan konsep untuk menyelesaikan persoalan. Baca stimulus dengan teliti dan periksa kembali kesimpulan.';showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">${esc(c)}</div><h2>${esc(t)}</h2><p class="muted">Ringkasan materi</p><div class="feature"><p>${esc(note)}</p><p><b>Strategi belajar:</b> pahami konsep dasar → pelajari contoh → kerjakan latihan → evaluasi kesalahan.</p><p class="small muted">Ringkasan pengantar untuk belajar mandiri. Tandai setelah selesai membaca agar progres tercatat.</p></div><div class="modalfoot"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Tutup</button><button class="btn" onclick="markTopic('${c}','${t}')">${done?'Sudah dipelajari':'Tandai dipelajari'}</button></div>`)}
    function markTopic(c,t){let k=data.currentUser+'|'+c+'|'+t;if(!data.studied.includes(k)){data.studied.push(k);data.history.push({id:crypto.randomUUID(),email:data.currentUser,type:'Materi dipelajari',label:t,date:dateISO(),total:0})}save();closeModal();render();toast('Progres materi diperbarui.')}

    {c:4,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Teks: 'Tanaman di pot A disiram setiap hari, sedangkan pot B disiram dua hari sekali.' Informasi pembanding yang digunakan adalah ....",o:["Warna pot", "Frekuensi penyiraman", "Jenis tanaman", "Ukuran halaman", "Harga air"],a:1,e:"Perbedaan yang disebutkan secara eksplisit adalah frekuensi penyiraman."},
    {c:4,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Kalimat opini ditunjukkan oleh ....",o:["Jumlah siswa 30 orang", "Air mendidih pada 100°C di tekanan 1 atm", "Perpustakaan itu tempat paling nyaman", "Sekolah berdiri pada 1990", "Pertemuan dimulai pukul 08.00"],a:2,e:"Kenyamanan bersifat penilaian subjektif."},
    {c:4,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Teks: 'Penggunaan botol isi ulang mengurangi sampah kemasan sekali pakai.' Gagasan utama kalimat tersebut adalah ....",o:["Cara membuat botol", "Manfaat botol isi ulang bagi pengurangan sampah", "Harga minuman kemasan", "Jenis plastik industri", "Sejarah air minum"],a:1,e:"Kalimat menekankan manfaat penggunaan botol isi ulang."},
    {c:4,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Sikap penulis yang menyajikan data dari beberapa penelitian dan membandingkannya cenderung ....",o:["Subjektif tanpa bukti", "Analitis berdasarkan bukti", "Menghibur dengan fiksi", "Menolak semua data", "Mengutamakan rumor"],a:1,e:"Perbandingan hasil penelitian menunjukkan pendekatan analitis berbasis bukti."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Choose the closest meaning of 'reluctant'.",o:["Eager", "Unwilling", "Certain", "Proud", "Careless"],a:1,e:"Reluctant means unwilling or hesitant to do something."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"The sentence 'Although the task was difficult, Nia completed it' shows ....",o:["Cause", "Contrast", "Addition", "Sequence", "Purpose"],a:1,e:"Although introduces a contrast between difficulty and completion."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Read: 'The library extended its hours during exam week. More students visited in the evening.' What is the most reasonable inference?",o:["The library closed earlier", "Evening access may help students study", "All students prefer mornings", "The exam was cancelled", "The library moved buildings"],a:1,e:"The longer hours provide an opportunity for evening visits."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Choose the grammatically correct sentence.",o:["She go to school every day.", "She goes to school every day.", "She going to school every day.", "She gone to school every day.", "She have go to school every day."],a:1,e:"A third-person singular subject in the simple present takes goes."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"The main purpose of an announcement about a lost wallet is to ....",o:["Tell a fairy tale", "Inform people about the missing item", "Explain a science experiment", "Review a restaurant", "Describe a holiday"],a:1,e:"A lost-item announcement provides information to help locate it."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"In the sentence 'The medicine should be stored in a cool, dry place,' the word 'stored' is closest in meaning to ....",o:["Kept", "Thrown", "Mixed", "Sold", "Opened"],a:0,e:"Stored means kept or placed somewhere for future use."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Read: 'Rafi missed the bus, so he decided to walk to school.' Why did Rafi walk?",o:["He missed the bus", "He wanted exercise", "The school was closed", "It was raining", "He lost his shoes"],a:0,e:"The text explicitly gives missing the bus as the reason."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Which connector best completes the sentence: 'The data was incomplete; ..., the team postponed its conclusion.'",o:["therefore", "meanwhile", "for example", "similarly", "instead of"],a:0,e:"Therefore expresses the consequence of incomplete data."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"A text that compares two renewable energy sources mainly aims to ....",o:["Compare their characteristics", "Narrate a personal journey", "Advertise a phone", "Give cooking instructions", "Describe a fictional hero"],a:0,e:"Comparing characteristics is the stated function of the text."},
    {c:5,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Choose the correct passive form of 'The committee approved the proposal.'",o:["The proposal approved the committee.", "The proposal was approved by the committee.", "The committee was approved by the proposal.", "The proposal is approve by committee.", "The proposal has approving."],a:1,e:"Simple past passive uses was/were + past participle: was approved."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Jika 3x − 4 = 17, nilai x adalah ....",o:["5", "6", "7", "8", "9"],a:2,e:"3x = 21 sehingga x = 7."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Sebuah mobil menempuh 150 km dalam 3 jam. Kecepatan rata-ratanya adalah ....",o:["30 km/jam", "40 km/jam", "50 km/jam", "60 km/jam", "75 km/jam"],a:2,e:"Kecepatan rata-rata = 150 ÷ 3 = 50 km/jam."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Luas segitiga dengan alas 10 cm dan tinggi 8 cm adalah ....",o:["18 cm²", "30 cm²", "40 cm²", "60 cm²", "80 cm²"],a:2,e:"Luas = 1/2 × 10 × 8 = 40 cm²."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Jika peluang muncul angka pada sebuah koin seimbang adalah ....",o:["0", "1/4", "1/3", "1/2", "1"],a:3,e:"Koin memiliki dua sisi dengan peluang sama; satu sisi angka berpeluang 1/2."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Rata-rata lima nilai adalah 80. Jumlah seluruh nilai tersebut adalah ....",o:["80", "160", "320", "400", "480"],a:3,e:"Jumlah data = rata-rata × banyak data = 80 × 5 = 400."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Sebuah tangki terisi 3/5 bagian. Jika kapasitasnya 200 liter, volume air di dalamnya adalah ....",o:["60 liter", "80 liter", "100 liter", "120 liter", "150 liter"],a:3,e:"3/5 × 200 = 120 liter."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Jika y = 2x + 1 dan x = 4, nilai y adalah ....",o:["7", "8", "9", "10", "11"],a:2,e:"Substitusi x = 4 menghasilkan y = 2(4) + 1 = 9."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Sebuah persegi memiliki luas 81 cm². Panjang sisinya adalah ....",o:["7 cm", "8 cm", "9 cm", "10 cm", "11 cm"],a:2,e:"Sisi persegi adalah akar kuadrat luas, yaitu 9 cm."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Dalam kelas terdapat 12 siswa laki-laki dan 18 siswa perempuan. Persentase siswa perempuan adalah ....",o:["40%", "50%", "60%", "65%", "70%"],a:2,e:"Total 30 siswa; 18/30 × 100% = 60%."},
    {c:6,t:"Latihan tambahan",q:"Barisan aritmetika memiliki suku pertama 5 dan beda 3. Suku ke-6 adalah ....",o:["17", "18", "20", "21", "23"],a:2,e:"Suku ke-6 = 5 + (6−1) × 3 = 20."}
    ];
    function practice(){return `${head('Latihan & Try Out','Pilih subtes untuk latihan terarah atau kerjakan try out gabungan.')}<div class="grid two"><div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">LATIHAN PER SUBTES</div><h3>Pilih subtes yang ingin dilatih</h3><div class="grid two">${categories.map((c,i)=>`<button class="btn ghost" style="text-align:left;min-height:62px" onclick="startSubtest(${i})"><span class="pill">0${i+1}</span><br>${c}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="feature"><b>10 soal untuk setiap subtes</b><p class="small muted">Soal diacak setiap kali latihan dimulai.</p></div><button class="btn" onclick="startQuiz(false)">Latihan gabungan →</button></div><div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">TRY OUT</div><h3>Uji kemampuan dengan timer</h3><p class="muted small">Pilih try out gabungan tujuh subtes atau buka halaman simulasi SNBT untuk melihat arsip soal tahun sebelumnya dari sumber eksternal.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn" onclick="go('tryout')">Mulai try out</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="go('simulation')">Arsip soal →</button></div></div></div>`}
    function startSubtest(i){let pool=questions.filter(q=>q.c===i);if(pool.length<10)return toast('Soal untuk subtes ini belum mencapai 10.');pool.sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);quiz={items:pool.slice(0,10),answers:{},flags:[],index:0,seconds:1200,start:Date.now(),isTryout:false,subtest:categories[i]};go('quiz');quizTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(!quiz)return;quiz.seconds--;let el=$('#timer');if(el)el.textContent=timerText();if(quiz.seconds<=0)finishQuiz()},1000)}
    function tryoutPage(){return `${head('Simulasi Tryout','Simulasi gabungan tujuh subtes. Soal bersifat latihan orisinal, bukan soal resmi.')}<div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">FULL PRACTICE SESSION</div><h2>Tryout UTBK-SNBT</h2><p class="muted">Uji kesiapanmu melalui 35 soal gabungan dari tujuh subtes. Waktu pengerjaan 60 menit.</p><div class="grid three"><div class="feature"><b>35</b><p class="small muted">Soal gabungan</p></div><div class="feature"><b>60 menit</b><p class="small muted">Batas waktu</p></div><div class="feature"><b>100</b><p class="small muted">Skor maksimal</p></div></div><button class="btn" style="margin-top:18px" onclick="startQuiz(true)">Mulai Simulasi Tryout →</button></div>`}
    function startQuiz(isTryout){
      let cat=+($('#practiceCat')?.value??-1),count=10,pool=[];
      if(isTryout){
        categories.forEach((_,i)=>{
          let group=questions.filter(q=>q.c===i).sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);
          pool.push(...group.slice(0,5));
        });
        pool.sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);
      }else{
        let available=questions.filter(q=>cat<0||q.c===cat).sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);
        pool=available.slice(0,Math.min(count,available.length));
      }
      if(!pool.length)return toast('Belum ada soal pada kategori ini.');
      quiz={items:pool,answers:{},flags:[],index:0,seconds:isTryout?3600:600,start:Date.now(),isTryout};
      go('quiz');quizTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(!quiz)return;quiz.seconds--;let el=$('#timer');if(el)el.textContent=timerText();if(quiz.seconds<=0)finishQuiz()},1000)
    }
    function timerText(){return Math.floor(quiz.seconds/60).toString().padStart(2,'0')+':'+(quiz.seconds%60).toString().padStart(2,'0')}
    function quizPage(){let q=quiz.items[quiz.index],n=quiz.index+1;return `${head(quiz.isTryout?'Simulasi Tryout':'Latihan Soal','Kerjakan dengan teliti. Pilih satu jawaban terbaik.',`<span class="pill gold" id="timer">⏱ ${timerText()}</span>`)}<div class="grid two"><div class="card"><div class="between"><span class="pill">${categories[q.c]}</span><span class="small muted">Soal ${n} dari ${quiz.items.length}</span></div><div class="question">${q.q}</div>${q.o.map((o,i)=>`<button class="option ${quiz.answers[quiz.index]===i?'selected':''}" onclick="answerQuestion(${i})">${'ABCDE'[i]}. ${o}</button>`).join('')}<div class="between" style="margin-top:20px"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="quizMove(-1)" ${quiz.index===0?'disabled':''}>← Sebelumnya</button><div class="row"><button class="iconbtn" onclick="flagQuestion()">${quiz.flags.includes(quiz.index)?'★ Ditandai':'☆ Tandai'}</button><button class="btn" onclick="quizMove(1)">${n===quiz.items.length?'Periksa':'Berikutnya →'}</button></div></div></div><div class="card"><h3>Navigasi Soal</h3><div class="numbergrid">${quiz.items.map((_,i)=>`<button class="${quiz.answers[i]!=null?'answered':''} ${quiz.flags.includes(i)?'flagged':''}" onclick="quiz.index=${i};render()">${i+1}</button>`).join('')}</div><p class="small muted">Biru: sudah dijawab · ★: ditandai untuk ditinjau.</p><div class="row"><span class="pill">${Object.keys(quiz.answers).length} dijawab</span><span class="pill">${quiz.items.length-Object.keys(quiz.answers).length} kosong</span></div><button class="btn gold" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px" onclick="finishQuiz()">Kumpulkan Jawaban</button></div></div>`}
    function answerQuestion(i){quiz.answers[quiz.index]=i;render()}
    function quizMove(n){quiz.index=Math.max(0,Math.min(quiz.items.length-1,quiz.index+n));render()}
    function flagQuestion(){let i=quiz.index;quiz.flags.includes(i)?quiz.flags=quiz.flags.filter(x=>x!==i):quiz.flags.push(i);render()}
    function finishQuiz(){if(!quiz)return;if(Object.keys(quiz.answers).length<quiz.items.length&&!confirm('Masih ada soal kosong. Kumpulkan sekarang?'))return;clearInterval(quizTimer);let correct=quiz.items.filter((q,i)=>quiz.answers[i]===q.a).length,total=quiz.items.length,score=Math.round(correct/total*100),elapsed=Math.round((Date.now()-quiz.start)/1000),record={id:crypto.randomUUID(),email:data.currentUser,type:quiz.isTryout?'Tryout':'Latihan',label:quiz.isTryout?'Tryout Gabungan':(quiz.subtest||'Latihan UTBK'),date:dateISO(),total,correct,wrong:Object.keys(quiz.answers).length-correct,blank:total-Object.keys(quiz.answers).length,score,seconds:elapsed,details:quiz.items.map((q,i)=>({q:q.q,answer:quiz.answers[i],correct:q.a,explain:q.e,options:q.o}))};data.history.push(record);data.scores.push({email:data.currentUser,score,date:dateISO()});save();quiz=null;go('result');window.lastResult=record}
    function resultPage(){let r=window.lastResult||userHistory().filter(x=>x.score!=null).slice(-1)[0];if(!r)return `${head('Hasil','Belum ada hasil latihan.')}<div class="card empty">Mulai latihan untuk melihat hasilmu.</div>`;return `${head('Hasil Evaluasi','Hasil latihanmu sudah tersimpan.')}<div class="card" style="text-align:center"><div class="eyebrow">YOUR SCORE</div><div style="font-size:65px;font-weight:800;color:#9bcaff">${r.score}</div><div class="muted">Skor akhir dari 100</div><div class="grid three" style="margin-top:20px"><div class="feature"><div class="stat">${r.correct}</div><div class="small muted">Benar</div></div><div class="feature"><div class="stat">${r.wrong}</div><div class="small muted">Salah</div></div><div class="feature"><div class="stat">${r.blank}</div><div class="small muted">Kosong</div></div></div><p class="muted small">Waktu pengerjaan: ${Math.floor(r.seconds/60)} menit ${r.seconds%60} detik</p></div><div class="card" style="margin-top:17px"><h3>Pembahasan</h3>${r.details.map((d,i)=>`<div style="padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #263b5c"><b>${i+1}. ${esc(d.q)}</b><p class="small">Jawaban kamu: ${d.answer==null?'Kosong':esc(d.options[d.answer])} · Kunci: <span style="color:#76dfb4">${esc(d.options[d.correct])}</span></p><p class="small muted">${esc(d.explain)}</p></div>`).join('')}<button class="btn" style="margin-top:15px" onclick="go('practice')">Latihan Lagi</button></div>`}
    function simulationPage(){return `${head('Simulasi SNBT & Arsip Soal','Akses latihan berdasarkan tahun ujian dan subtes. Periksa keterangan sumber sebelum mengerjakan.')}<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:17px"><div class="eyebrow">ARSIP SOAL TAHUN SEBELUMNYA</div><h2>Bank referensi soal UTBK / SNBT</h2><p class="muted small">Naskah soal asli tidak diterbitkan sebagai bank soal resmi terbuka oleh panitia SNPMB. Tautan berikut menuju arsip pihak ketiga yang mengklaim mengumpulkan soal tahun sebelumnya. Cek label tahun, subtes, dan keterangan sumber pada masing-masing paket.</p><div class="tag-row"><span class="pill">2026</span><span class="pill">2025</span><span class="pill">2024</span><span class="pill">2023</span><span class="pill">2022–2020</span></div></div><div class="grid two"><div class="card archive-card"><span class="pill gold">Arsip pihak ketiga</span><h3>Pintarly — Arsip Soal Asli UTBK/SNBT</h3><p class="small muted">Halaman arsip menampilkan paket per tahun dan subtes, termasuk 2026, 2025, 2024, 2023, dan tahun-tahun sebelumnya. Periksa keterangan dan akses tiap paket di situs sumber.</p><a class="btn" href="https://www.pintarly.id/soal-asli" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Buka arsip Pintarly ↗</a><div class="mini-meta">Sumber eksternal · bukan bagian dari sistem SeSyAM</div></div><div class="card archive-card"><span class="pill">Arsip dan referensi</span><h3>AmbisPTN — Arsip Ujian Masuk PTN</h3><p class="small muted">Kumpulan arsip berdasarkan tahun ujian, dengan penjelasan perubahan format dari SNMPTN tertulis, SBMPTN, UTBK-SBMPTN, hingga UTBK-SNBT.</p><a class="btn ghost" href="https://ambisptn.com/soal-utbk" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Buka arsip AmbisPTN ↗</a><div class="mini-meta">Sumber eksternal · periksa status paket yang tersedia</div></div><div class="card archive-card"><span class="pill green">Acuan resmi</span><h3>SNPMB — Informasi UTBK-SNBT</h3><p class="small muted">Gunakan laman resmi untuk mengecek komponen tes, ketentuan, jadwal, dan pengumuman terbaru. Ini bukan bank soal tahun lalu.</p><a class="btn ghost" href="https://snpmb.id/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Buka laman SNPMB ↗</a></div><div class="card archive-card"><span class="pill gold">Simulasi di SeSyAM</span><h3>Try Out buatan SeSyAM 12</h3><p class="small muted">Kerjakan soal latihan orisinal yang tersedia di website ini dengan timer, hasil skor, dan pembahasan.</p><button class="btn" onclick="go('tryout')">Mulai try out SeSyAM →</button></div></div><div class="card" style="margin-top:17px"><h3>Catatan penting tentang soal asli</h3><p class="small muted">Soal pada tautan eksternal dikelola oleh situs masing-masing. SeSyAM 12 tidak menyalin atau mengklaim memiliki seluruh naskah soal tersebut. Jika suatu paket merupakan rekonstruksi, prediksi, atau ingatan peserta, status itu harus mengikuti keterangan dari penerbitnya.</p></div>`}
    function chancePage(){return `${head('Simulasi Peluang SNBT','Analisis rasio persaingan program studi, bukan prediksi kelulusan.')}<div class="grid two"><div class="card"><h3>Data Program Studi</h3><form id="chanceForm"><div class="field"><label>Skor tryout kamu</label><input type="number" name="score" min="0" max="1000" value="${avgScore()||650}" required></div><div class="field"><label>Nama PTN</label><input name="ptn" placeholder="Contoh: Universitas Indonesia" required></div><div class="field"><label>Program studi</label><input name="prodi" placeholder="Contoh: Ilmu Komputer" required></div><div class="grid two"><div class="field"><label>Jumlah peminat</label><input name="interest" type="number" min="1" required placeholder="1200"></div><div class="field"><label>Daya tampung</label><input name="capacity" type="number" min="1" required placeholder="60"></div></div><button class="btn">Analisis Persaingan</button></form></div><div class="card" id="chanceResult"><div class="eyebrow">CATATAN PENTING</div><h3>Gunakan data yang valid</h3><p class="muted small">Masukkan jumlah peminat dan daya tampung dari sumber resmi tahun yang relevan. Sistem menghitung rasio peminat per kursi dan mengelompokkan tingkat persaingan secara sederhana.</p><p class="small muted">Hasil bukan peluang diterima dan tidak menjamin kelulusan. Seleksi dipengaruhi banyak faktor, termasuk skor, pemilihan prodi, dan kebijakan tahun berjalan.</p></div></div>`}
    function goalsPage(){let arr=data.goals.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),pct=arr.length?Math.round(arr.reduce((a,g)=>a+(g.progress||0),0)/arr.length):0;return `${head('Target Belajar','Buat target sendiri atau gunakan saran target belajar sebagai titik awal.',`<button class="btn" onclick="openGoal()">+ Buat Target</button>`)}<div class="grid two"><div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">TARGET SAYA</div><div class="stat">${pct}%</div><div class="progress"><span style="width:${pct}%"></span></div><p class="small muted">Rata-rata progres seluruh targetmu.</p></div><div class="recommendation"><div class="eyebrow">SARAN TARGET BELAJAR</div><h3>Mulai dari target yang realistis</h3><p class="small muted">• Pelajari 2 topik materi setiap minggu.<br>• Kerjakan 20–30 soal per hari belajar.<br>• Ikuti 1 try out setiap akhir pekan.<br>• Evaluasi 2 subtes dengan skor terendah.</p><button class="btn ghost" onclick="addSuggestedGoals()">+ Tambahkan saran ke target saya</button></div></div><div class="grid two" style="margin-top:17px">${arr.length?arr.map(g=>`<div class="card"><div class="between"><span class="pill ${g.done?'green':''}">${g.done?'Tercapai':'Dalam proses'}</span><div class="row"><button class="iconbtn" onclick="openGoal('${g.id}')">✎ Edit</button><button class="iconbtn" onclick="deleteGoal('${g.id}')">×</button></div></div><h3>${esc(g.title)}</h3><p class="small muted">${esc(g.desc||'Target belajar')} · ${esc(g.type||'Target')}</p><div class="between"><span class="small muted">${g.progress||0}% selesai</span><button class="iconbtn" onclick="progressGoal('${g.id}')">+10%</button></div><div class="progress"><span style="width:${g.progress||0}%"></span></div></div>`).join(''):'<div class="card empty">Belum ada target. Buat target atau tambahkan saran belajar.</div>'}</div>`}
    function openGoal(id){let g=data.goals.find(x=>x.id===id)||{};showModal(`<h2>${id?'Edit Target':'Buat Target Baru'}</h2><form id="goalForm"><div class="field"><label>Nama target</label><input name="title" required value="${esc(g.title||'')}" placeholder="Contoh: Selesaikan materi Penalaran Umum"></div><div class="field"><label>Deskripsi</label><textarea name="desc" placeholder="Target yang ingin dicapai...">${esc(g.desc||'')}</textarea></div><div class="field"><label>Jenis target</label><select name="type">${['Materi','Jumlah soal','Jam belajar','Skor tryout','Target PTN'].map(t=>`<option ${g.type===t?'selected':''}>${t}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Progres saat ini (%)</label><input name="progress" type="number" min="0" max="100" value="${g.progress||0}"></div><div class="modalfoot"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Batal</button><button class="btn">Simpan Target</button></div></form>`);$('#goalForm').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();let f=new FormData(e.target),progress=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,+f.get('progress'))),obj={id:id||crypto.randomUUID(),email:data.currentUser,title:f.get('title'),desc:f.get('desc'),type:f.get('type'),progress,done:progress===100};if(id)data.goals=data.goals.map(x=>x.id===id?obj:x);else data.goals.push(obj);save();closeModal();render();toast('Target berhasil disimpan.')}}
    function addSuggestedGoals(){let suggestions=[['Pelajari 2 topik materi UTBK','Selesaikan dua topik materi pilihan minggu ini.','Materi'],['Kerjakan 100 soal latihan','Kumpulkan 100 soal dari berbagai subtes dalam satu minggu.','Jumlah soal'],['Ikuti 1 try out dan evaluasi','Kerjakan satu try out, lalu catat subtes yang perlu ditingkatkan.','Skor tryout']];suggestions.forEach(x=>data.goals.push({id:crypto.randomUUID(),email:data.currentUser,title:x[0],desc:x[1],type:x[2],progress:0,done:false}));save();render();toast('Saran target ditambahkan.')}
    function progressGoal(id){let g=data.goals.find(x=>x.id===id);g.progress=Math.min(100,g.progress+10);g.done=g.progress===100;save();render()}
    function deleteGoal(id){if(confirm('Hapus target?')){data.goals=data.goals.filter(x=>x.id!==id);save();render()}}
    function progressPage(){let studied=data.studied.filter(x=>x.startsWith(data.currentUser+'|')).length,arr=userHistory(),schedules=data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),goals=data.goals.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),doneSchedules=schedules.filter(x=>x.done).length,goalPct=goals.length?Math.round(goals.reduce((a,g)=>a+(g.progress||0),0)/goals.length):0,targetQ=profile().targetQuestions||150,questionPct=Math.min(100,Math.round(totalQuestions()/targetQ*100)),materialTotal=Object.values(topics).reduce((a,x)=>a+x.length,0),materialPct=Math.round(studied/materialTotal*100),schedulePct=schedules.length?Math.round(doneSchedules/schedules.length*100):0,overall=Math.round(materialPct*.35+questionPct*.30+schedulePct*.20+goalPct*.15),lastSchedule=schedules.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.date+b.start).localeCompare(a.date+a.start))[0];return `${head('Pantauan Progress','Persentase dihitung dari materi yang dipelajari, soal, jadwal selesai, dan target belajar.')}<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:17px"><div class="between"><div><div class="eyebrow">TOTAL PERKEMBANGAN BELAJAR</div><div class="stat">${overall}%</div><p class="small muted">Gabungan indikator aktivitas belajar yang tersimpan.</p></div><div class="progress-ring">${overall}%</div></div><div class="progress"><span style="width:${overall}%"></span></div></div><div class="grid stats"><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">TOTAL JAM BELAJAR</div><div class="stat">${durationHours().toFixed(1)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">SOAL DIKERJAKAN</div><div class="stat">${totalQuestions()}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">RATA-RATA SKOR</div><div class="stat">${avgScore()}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="statlabel">MATERI DIBACA</div><div class="stat">${studied}/${materialTotal}</div></div></div><div class="grid two" style="margin-top:17px"><div class="card"><h3>Rincian Persentase</h3>${[['Materi dipelajari',materialPct],['Target jumlah soal',questionPct],['Jadwal diselesaikan',schedulePct],['Target belajar',goalPct]].map(x=>`<div style="margin:14px 0"><div class="between"><span class="small">${x[0]}</span><b>${x[1]}%</b></div><div class="progress"><span style="width:${x[1]}%"></span></div></div>`).join('')}<p class="mini-meta">Bobot: materi 35%, soal 30%, jadwal 20%, target 15%. Persentase adalah indikator aktivitas, bukan prediksi nilai SNBT.</p></div><div class="card"><h3>Aktivitas Terakhir</h3>${arr.length?arr.slice().reverse().slice(0,5).map(x=>`<div style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #263b5c"><b class="small">${esc(x.type)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(x.label||'Aktivitas belajar')} · ${fmtDate(x.date)}</div></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty">Belum ada aktivitas belajar.</div>'}<h3 style="margin-top:18px">Jadwal Terakhir</h3>${lastSchedule?`<div class="feature"><b>${esc(lastSchedule.category)}</b><p class="small muted">${fmtDate(lastSchedule.date)} · ${lastSchedule.start}–${lastSchedule.end}</p><span class="pill ${lastSchedule.done?'green':''}">${lastSchedule.done?'Selesai':'Belum selesai'}</span></div>`:'<p class="small muted">Belum ada jadwal tersimpan.</p>'}<button class="btn ghost" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="go('schedule')">Buka jadwal →</button></div></div><div class="grid two" style="margin-top:17px"><div class="card"><h3>Grafik Perkembangan Skor</h3>${scoreBars()}</div><div class="card"><h3>Penguasaan Materi per Subtes</h3>${categories.map(c=>{let all=topics[c].length,done=topics[c].filter(t=>data.studied.includes(data.currentUser+'|'+c+'|'+t)).length;return `<div class="barrow"><span>${c.split(' ').slice(0,2).join(' ')}</span><div class="bar"><i style="width:${done/all*100}%"></i></div><b>${done}/${all}</b></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`}
    function historyPage(){let a=userHistory().slice().reverse();return `${head('Riwayat Aktivitas','Semua aktivitas belajar dan hasil latihanmu.')}<div class="card"><div class="between"><h3>Aktivitas Terbaru</h3><span class="pill">${a.length} aktivitas</span></div>${a.length?`<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Aktivitas</th><th>Detail</th><th>Skor</th></tr></thead><tbody>${a.map(x=>`<tr><td>${fmtDate(x.date)}</td><td>${esc(x.type)}</td><td>${esc(x.label||'—')}</td><td>${x.score??'—'}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`:'<div class="empty">Belum ada aktivitas. Mulai belajar untuk mengisi riwayatmu.</div>'}</div>`}
    function profilePage(){let p=profile();return `${head('Profil Saya','Lengkapi profil dan tujuan pendidikanmu.')}<div class="card"><form id="profileForm"><div class="grid two"><div class="field"><label>Nama lengkap</label><input name="name" value="${esc(p.name||user().name)}" required></div><div class="field"><label>Username</label><input value="${esc(p.username||user().email?.split('@')[0]||'')}" disabled></div><div class="field"><label>Asal sekolah</label><input name="school" value="${esc(p.school||'')}" placeholder="Nama sekolah"></div><div class="field"><label>Kelas</label><select name="grade"><option ${p.grade==='12'?'selected':''}>12</option><option ${p.grade==='11'?'selected':''}>11</option><option ${p.grade==='10'?'selected':''}>10</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Target PTN</label><input name="targetPTN" value="${esc(p.targetPTN||'')}" placeholder="PTN impian"></div><div class="field"><label>Program studi impian</label><input name="targetProdi" value="${esc(p.targetProdi||'')}" placeholder="Program studi"></div><div class="field"><label>Target jam belajar / minggu</label><input name="targetHours" type="number" min="1" value="${p.targetHours||20}"></div><div class="field"><label>Target soal / minggu</label><input name="targetQuestions" type="number" min="1" value="${p.targetQuestions||150}"></div></div><button class="btn">Simpan Profil</button></form></div>`}
    function settingsPage(){return `${head('Pengaturan','Atur pengingat dan kelola data lokal.')}<div class="grid two"><div class="card"><h3>Pengingat Belajar</h3><p class="muted small">Izinkan notifikasi browser agar pengingat dapat ditampilkan saat halaman terbuka.</p><div class="row"><button class="btn" onclick="enableReminder()">Aktifkan Notifikasi</button><span class="pill">${data.settings.reminder?'Aktif':'Belum aktif'}</span></div><div class="field"><label>Jam pengingat harian</label><input id="reminderTime" type="time" value="${data.settings.time||'19:00'}"></div><button class="btn ghost" onclick="saveReminder()">Simpan Pengaturan</button></div><div class="card"><h3>Data & Privasi</h3><p class="small muted">Data belajar disimpan pada Firestore di akun Firebase kamu dan disinkronkan saat online. Data akun dipisahkan berdasarkan UID pengguna.</p><button class="btn ghost" onclick="exportData()">Unduh Cadangan Data</button> <button class="btn danger" onclick="clearMyData()">Hapus Data Akun Ini</button></div></div>`}
    function enableReminder(){if(!('Notification'in window))return toast('Browser tidak mendukung notifikasi.');Notification.requestPermission().then(p=>{data.settings.reminder=p==='granted';save();render();toast(p==='granted'?'Notifikasi diizinkan.':'Izin notifikasi tidak diberikan.')})}
    function saveReminder(){data.settings.time=$('#reminderTime').value;save();toast('Pengaturan pengingat disimpan.')}
    function exportData(){let obj={profile:profile(),schedules:data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),goals:data.goals.filter(x=>x.email===data.currentUser),history:userHistory(),studied:data.studied.filter(x=>x.startsWith(data.currentUser+'|'))};let a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(obj,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));a.download='sesyam12-backup.json';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href)}
    function clearMyData(){if(!confirm('Hapus semua data belajar akun ini? Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.'))return;let em=data.currentUser;data.schedules=data.schedules.filter(x=>x.email!==em);data.goals=data.goals.filter(x=>x.email!==em);data.history=data.history.filter(x=>x.email!==em);data.studied=data.studied.filter(x=>!x.startsWith(em+'|'));delete data.profiles[em];save();toast('Data belajar akun dihapus.');go('dashboard')}
    function content(){switch(page){case'dashboard':return dashboard();case'schedule':return schedulePage();case'materials':return materials();case'practice':return practice();case'tryout':return tryoutPage();case'simulation':return simulationPage();case'quiz':return quizPage();case'result':return resultPage();case'chance':return chancePage();case'goals':return goalsPage();case'progress':return progressPage();case'history':return historyPage();case'profile':return profilePage();case'settings':return settingsPage();default:return dashboard()}}
    function showModal(s){$('#modalRoot').innerHTML=`<div class="modalback" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeModal()"><div class="modal">${s}</div></div>`}
    function closeModal(){$('#modalRoot').innerHTML=''}
    async function logout(){if(!confirm(guestMode?'Akhiri mode tamu? Data tamu tetap tersimpan di perangkat ini.':'Keluar dari akun?'))return;if(guestMode||localAccountMode){guestMode=false;localAccountMode=false;localAccountUsername='';data=structuredClone(defaultData);page='landing';render();return}try{await window.firebaseBridge.logout()}catch(err){toast(authError(err))}}
    function render(){if(!data.currentUser){$('#app').innerHTML=page==='login'?auth('login'):page==='register'?auth('register'):landing();return}$('#app').innerHTML=shell();if(page==='chance')$('#chanceForm').onsubmit=chanceSubmit;if(page==='profile')$('#profileForm').onsubmit=profileSubmit}
    function chanceSubmit(e){e.preventDefault();let f=new FormData(e.target),interest=+f.get('interest'),cap=+f.get('capacity');if(cap<=0||interest<=0)return;let ratio=interest/cap,level=ratio>=30?'Sangat ketat':ratio>=15?'Ketat':ratio>=7?'Kompetitif':'Relatif lebih rendah';$('#chanceResult').innerHTML=`<div class="eyebrow">HASIL ANALISIS</div><h3>${esc(f.get('prodi'))} · ${esc(f.get('ptn'))}</h3><div class="stat">${ratio.toFixed(1)} : 1</div><p class="muted small">Rasio peminat per kursi</p><span class="pill ${ratio>=15?'red':ratio>=7?'gold':'green'}">${level}</span><div class="grid two" style="margin-top:15px"><div class="feature"><b>${interest.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</b><p class="small muted">Peminat</p></div><div class="feature"><b>${cap.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</b><p class="small muted">Daya tampung</p></div></div><p class="small muted">Skor tryout: ${f.get('score')}. Gunakan skor ini untuk memantau kesiapan, bukan sebagai peluang diterima.</p><p class="small">Strategi: tingkatkan subtes dengan skor terendah, lakukan tryout berkala, dan siapkan pilihan prodi alternatif berdasarkan minat serta data resmi.</p><p class="small muted">Simulasi rasio sederhana, bukan prediksi atau jaminan kelulusan SNBT.</p>`}
    function profileSubmit(e){e.preventDefault();let f=new FormData(e.target);data.profiles[data.currentUser]={...profile(),name:f.get('name'),school:f.get('school'),grade:f.get('grade'),targetPTN:f.get('targetPTN'),targetProdi:f.get('targetProdi'),targetHours:+f.get('targetHours'),targetQuestions:+f.get('targetQuestions')};user().name=f.get('name');save();toast('Profil berhasil disimpan.');render()}
    document.addEventListener('click',e=>{let a=e.target.closest('a[href="#"]');if(a)e.preventDefault()});
    if(!window.firebaseBridge)render();
    setInterval(()=>{if(data.currentUser&&data.settings.reminder&&data.settings.time===new Date().toTimeString().slice(0,5)&&!window.remindedToday){window.remindedToday=dateISO();if('Notification'in window&&Notification.permission==='granted')new Notification('SeSyAM 12',{body:'Waktunya belajar! Cek jadwal UTBK-mu hari ini.'})}},20000);
    </script>
    <script type="module">
    import { initializeApp } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js';
    import { getAuth, onAuthStateChanged, createUserWithEmailAndPassword, signInWithEmailAndPassword, sendPasswordResetEmail, updateProfile, signOut } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-auth.js';
    import { getFirestore, doc, getDoc, setDoc, serverTimestamp } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js';

    // GANTI nilai di bawah dengan konfigurasi Firebase Web App milik SeSyAM 12.
    const firebaseConfig = {
      apiKey: 'GANTI_DENGAN_API_KEY',
      authDomain: 'GANTI_DENGAN_PROJECT_ID.firebaseapp.com',
      projectId: 'GANTI_DENGAN_PROJECT_ID',
      storageBucket: 'GANTI_DENGAN_PROJECT_ID.appspot.com',
      messagingSenderId: 'GANTI_DENGAN_SENDER_ID',
      appId: 'GANTI_DENGAN_APP_ID'
    };
    const configured = Object.values(firebaseConfig).every(v => v && !String(v).startsWith('GANTI_'));
    if (!configured) {
      console.warn('SeSyAM 12: Firebase belum dikonfigurasi. Mode tamu tetap dapat digunakan; login dan sinkronisasi cloud belum aktif.');
    } else {
      const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
      const auth = getAuth(app);
      const db = getFirestore(app);
      let writeQueue = Promise.resolve();
      const userDoc = uid => doc(db, 'users', uid, 'private', 'learningData');
      window.firebaseBridge = {
        usernameEmail: username => `${String(username).trim().toLowerCase()}@sesyam12.app`,
        login: (username,password) => signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth,`${String(username).trim().toLowerCase()}@sesyam12.app`,password),
        register: async (name,username,password) => { const email=`${String(username).trim().toLowerCase()}@sesyam12.app`; const cred=await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth,email,password); await updateProfile(cred.user,{displayName:name}); await setDoc(userDoc(cred.user.uid),{profile:{name,username,school:'',grade:'12',targetPTN:'',targetProdi:'',targetHours:20,targetQuestions:150},username, schedules:[],goals:[],history:[],studied:[],scores:[],settings:{reminder:false},updatedAt:serverTimestamp()}); return cred; },
        resetPassword: email => sendPasswordResetEmail(auth,email),
        logout: async () => { await writeQueue.catch(()=>{}); await signOut(auth); },
        save: snapshot => {
          const uid=auth.currentUser?.uid;
          if(!uid) return Promise.reject(new Error('Belum login'));
          writeQueue=writeQueue.then(()=>setDoc(userDoc(uid),{...snapshot,updatedAt:serverTimestamp()}));
          return writeQueue;
        }
      };
      onAuthStateChanged(auth, async user => {
        window.firebaseUser=user;
        if(!user){
          if(guestMode)return;
          window.firebaseSignedIn=null;
          data.currentUser=null; data.users=[]; data.profiles={}; data.schedules=[]; data.goals=[]; data.history=[]; data.studied=[]; data.scores=[]; data.settings={reminder:false};
          page='landing'; render(); return;
        }
        try {
          const snap=await getDoc(userDoc(user.uid));
          const saved=snap.exists()?snap.data():{};
          const email=user.email;
          data={users:[{email,name:user.displayName||saved.profile?.name||email}],currentUser:email,profiles:{[email]:saved.profile||{name:user.displayName||email,school:'',grade:'12',targetPTN:'',targetProdi:'',targetHours:20,targetQuestions:150}},schedules:(saved.schedules||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),goals:(saved.goals||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),history:(saved.history||[]).map(x=>({...x,email})),studied:saved.studied||[],settings:saved.settings||{reminder:false},scores:(saved.scores||[]).map(x=>({...x,email}))};
          window.firebaseSignedIn=user; page='dashboard'; render();
        } catch(err) {
          console.error(err); toast('Gagal memuat data akun. Periksa Firestore Rules dan koneksi.');
        }
      });
    }
    </script>

    </body>
    </html>
